summary: No security regression found. Control-server ports narrow the config surface reaching adapters (an improvement); the neutral E2E credential mapping keeps the GitHub secret name and scope unchanged with the key still reaching only the real-model step's env; the sandbox copy change is test-only; session-interaction approval wording changes carry no authorization change; provider-boundary exceptions were tightened or removed, never widened, and the one new exception (sentinel names) is exact-count capped with a ledgered review trigger.
residual_risks: The frozen-doc marker mechanism is now allowlist-enforced; its abuse path (stamping a live doc) is a checker violation rather than a silent bypass.
